description: Active students who have not finished a workout in the last N days (7 by default), with name, phone to reach out (the guardian's for a dependent), last workout date, days since and the app_url of the student profile, longest absence first. Students who never trained come first. has_active_workout false means the trainer never gave this student a workout: open workouts_url (the student's workouts screen) or use create_workout before reaching out. Use it to answer "who disappeared this week?" and then get_student or list_student_sessions for one of them. Read only: nothing is sent to the student.

days.description: Days without a finished workout, 1 to 30. Default 7.

name: list_inactive_students
